Agent Name: Historian_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Historian_Expert made the first critical error in Step 1 by incorrectly identifying the destination of the "first citation reference link" on Carl Nebel's Wikipedia page. The conversation history clearly shows the first citation reference (marked as `[[1]](#cite_note-thb-1)`) points to "Thieme-Becker" (a German biographical dictionary), not the Museum of Fine Arts, Houston (MFAH) website. The Historian_Expert hallucinated that the link leads to `https://emuseum.mfah.org/people/8856/carl-nebel`, which is factually incorrect based on the provided Wikipedia content. This foundational error led to all subsequent steps (fetching the wrong page, finding the wrong image, and attempting OCR on an unrelated image) being performed on the wrong source, ultimately causing the failure to solve the actual problem.
